dimensions.assessment: Affects the Forest Service, federal firefighting personnel, state and local firefighting agencies, and populations residing near or visiting covered National Forest System lands.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of Agriculture, acting through the Chief of the Forest Service... shall use all available resources to carry out wildfire suppression

dimensions.assessment: Mandates rigid 24-hour extinguishment timeframes using all available resources and places strict limitations on prescribed burns and backfires, significantly altering firefighting strategy on covered lands.
dimensions.evidence: use all available resources to carry out wildfire suppression with the purpose of extinguishing wildfires detected on such lands not later than 24 hours after such a wildfire is detected

dimensions.assessment: Requires the intensive marshalling of 'all available resources' for rapid suppression on qualifying lands, which may concentrate existing federal firefighting expenditures.
dimensions.evidence: use all available resources to carry out wildfire suppression

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new nationwide statutory restrictions on Forest Service management tools, backfire authorizations, and coordination with state and local firefighting bodies.
dimensions.evidence: may only use fire as a resource management tool if the fire is a prescribed fire that complies with applicable law and regulations

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent operational and legal rules for wildfire management across all qualifying National Forest System lands whenever drought or preparedness thresholds are met.
dimensions.evidence: With respect to covered National Forest System lands, the Secretary of Agriculture... shall--

missing_information: Total acreage of National Forest System lands that currently meet the severe drought, preparedness level 5, or top 10% fireshed exposure criteria.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill imposes strict federal wildfire suppression requirements on specified National Forest System lands under high drought, preparedness, or exposure conditions, mandating the use of all available resources to extinguish fires within 24 hours and restricting prescribed fires and backfires.
